source_snapshot.procedure: 【Before Test】 verify configuration and clear logs. 【During Test】 power up; log into BMC; enter Advanced License; open Power Settings; record Maximum Available, Peak Observed and Minimum Observed watts; enable capping; set cap to Maximum Available; Apply; run OS stress for 30 hr. 【After Test】 collect results/photos and inspect logs.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. CPU is capping the power utilization.
2. Average Power should be below Power Cap; Maximum Power may cross above it.

original_test_intent: The title requests maximum CPU cap inventory, while the preserved body instead enables and writes a cap and runs 30-hour stress to prove capping.
original_method: Preserve both scopes as conflicting evidence. Do not execute until engineering separates read-only maximum-limit inventory from any cap enable/write/stress validation and assigns acceptance to each.
manual_activity: Engineer must decide whether this identity is a read-only Get-max case or retains cap-write/stress coverage; if both are required, approve separate checkpoints, controls and verdicts.
required_inputs: Safe cap/stress/restore contract if write remains
safety_requirements: Do not execute mixed current procedure.
Do not install a license, write a cap or stress under a Get-only assumption.
Do not claim functional coverage from read-only telemetry.
No log clear or automatic retry.
Preserve original cap state for any future approved write.
agent_execution_scope: Static conflict analysis only while blocked.
After scope correction, automate protected maximum-limit collection if read-only.
Handle any cap/stress path only as a separately approved interlocked workflow.
engineer_actions: Split or select the authoritative scope.
Define field semantics, acceptance and safety contract.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Read-only telemetry may support a future Get-max case but cannot satisfy the preserved license, enable, Apply and 30-hour stress steps; guessed URI, grep and insecure secret/TLS handling are also unsuitable.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No executable workflow until scope is resolved; then discover the actual protected resource and either read the vendor-defined maximum or separately implement approved write/stress/restoration.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Title, Advanced License, recorded watt fields, Maximum Available cap, 30-hour stress, 10/1440-minute metadata and Criteria are retained as conflict evidence.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Split into read-only maximum-limit inventory and state-changing cap validation, then re-review each coverage boundary.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Project platform with vendor-defined cap schema and license tier.

modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Owner scope decision and per-scope acceptance.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Running the body changes persistent performance policy; running only the title misses functional coverage.

Protected read-only maximum-limit evidence if selected

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Get-max title implies read-only inventory, but Procedure and Criteria require license entry, cap enable/write and 30-hour enforcement stress; duration metadata also says 1440 minutes rather than 30 hours.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The core operation and pass condition are not uniquely defined. Selecting read or write without engineering would either change the test or erase required coverage.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects the read-only downgrade and unsafe guessed transport.

review_improvement: Stops a Get label from hiding a persistent cap change and prevents a telemetry-only result from being presented as 30-hour enforcement validation.
independent_technical_reasoning: Maximum Available Power, configured PowerLimit and observed peak are not interchangeable. A read parser can automate inventory, whereas license entry, policy write and stress need approval and recovery. Because the record combines both, automation classification cannot safely proceed until its semantic boundary is corrected.
